name: kabo-alpha
description: Kabo creator Skill distribution client: search, download, verify the signature of, and execute platform skills. Tool-level telemetry is recorded server-side; this variant collects no client-side usage events.

interface.shortDescription: Search, verify, and run Kabo creator analysis skills
interface.longDescription: Connects to the Kabo MCP platform, dynamically searches and downloads creator data analysis skills, and after signature verification runs them inline or in a Codex subagent. Tool-level telemetry is recorded by the server inside the tool handler; the client collects no usage events.
defaultPrompt: Use Kabo to find the outlier videos in my niche and break down why they worked.
Compare my channel's recent videos against its best performers.
Reverse-engineer the viral Instagram Reels in my niche.
